summary: Defined eight congruence-indicator features (moduli 2,3,4,5,7,8,11,12) on residues 0..59 and formed their unweighted Gram kernel. It has trace 480 and feature rank at most 52; the PSD property is immediate from the Gram factorization, so this finite check found no learned-modulus signal. The requested R(p) GP fit was not performed.
next: Use repository R(p) targets to fit and validate the arithmetic kernel.

summary: Fixed the unweighted test as the Popoviciu denumerant identity for coprime 2≤a,b≤15 and 0≤n<2ab. All 16,428 exact counts agreed with the formula (0 failures); this verifies the identity only, not the unspecified ES-weighted sum or a Dedekind-sum reduction.
not_done: An ES-relevant summation domain/weight and reciprocity evaluation.
next: Specify an ES-derived weight and test whether its complete sum reduces to Dedekind sums.

summary: Defined the natural first-sextant lattice-point proxy in Z[ω], with N(a+bω)=a²−ab+b²≤10⁴ and angle 0..π/3. Enumerated 9,152 points representing 2,299 distinct norms (two sector points of norm 1); this does not test an Eisenstein Egyptian-fraction analogue or its failures.
not_done: The actual fractional-decomposition relation and a divisor/failure search in that sibling.
next: Define the Eisenstein analogue equation, then enumerate and certify it through norm 10⁴.

summary: Fixed the family as n²+n+41 for 0≤n<100,000 and filtered exact primes p≡1 mod4. Found 15,951 qualifying primes (first 41,53,61,97; last values near 9,999,100,061); this family count alone says nothing about the proposed R(p)/M_BM comparison.
not_done: Repository R and M_BM values joined to these prime parameters and matched controls.
next: Compute R/M_BM on the qualifying family and compare with residue-matched primes.

summary: Fixed the nested moduli as 840, 840·11=9,240, and 840·11·13=120,120, and counted primes p≤10⁸ congruent to 1: 30,061, 2,972, and 235 respectively. These are sample sizes only; the proposed R/M means were not evaluated, and a reliable per-prime witness/normalizer computation remains necessary.
not_done: R/M evaluator and matched-control means; no self-similarity conclusion.
next: Implement and validate per-prime R/M, then compute the three nested-class means.

summary: Fixed the first test to K=1 with s=2^j, 0≤j<16, and searched exact positive three-unit decompositions with denominators x≤10,000 and y≤min(10,000,⌊(4/p−1/s)⁻¹⌋+5,000) for p≡1 mod4, p≤5,000. Among 329 primes and 2,251 positive (p,s) pairs, the bounded search found 0; this is only bounded-search evidence, not a least-K result.
not_done: Unbounded denominator search and K>1 tuples.
next: Run a complete divisor-based three-unit solver for K=1, then extend to K>1.

summary: Fixed the only canonical finite baseline available as the 192 unit residues modulo 840. The record still supplies no ES coordinate involutions or transition rule, so this state count does not test orbit coverage and supports no comparison to the Mordell cover.
not_done: A specified set of ES moves and resulting orbit computation.
next: Define explicit transformations on ES certificates before computing residue orbits.

summary: Fixed a concrete continuant baseline: all binary words of lengths 4, 8, and 12, evaluated by the standard continuant recurrence. Maximum values were 5, 34, and 233 (one maximizer each); these Stern-style maxima do not bound an ES word graph absent an explicit ES move map.
not_done: ES length-three word graph and map from the cited extremal operation.
next: Specify ES word moves and test whether their continuants satisfy the same extremal recurrence.

summary: Tested the standard exact splitting identity 1/a=1/(a+1)+1/(a(a+1)) at a=1,2,3,5,11. It always changes one term into two, so this common construction does not itself preserve a fixed three-term ES family; no transfer claim is made.
not_done: Full paper construction and other potential denominator maps.
next: Extract the paper’s full construction and check for a distinct exactly-three-term transformation.

summary: Fixed the standard Lüroth digit map d=⌊1/x⌋+1 and residual d(d−1)x−(d−1) for x=4/p, primes p≡1 mod4 through 101. It produced 12 inputs; for example p=5 gives digit 2 and residual 3/5, and p=41 gives digit 11 and residual 30/41. No implication from three digits to an ES decomposition follows from these data.
not_done: Constrained three-digit implication or exhaustive digit-tuple test.
next: Enumerate exact Lüroth prefixes and test an explicit three-digit-to-ES rule.

summary: Fixed positive continued-fraction matrices with digits 1..A, length 3, and denominator target q=abc+a+c. For A=1,2,3,5,10 there are 1,8,27,125,1,000 words and 1,6,16,54,327 distinct targets respectively; this combinatorial count is not an ES₅ transfer-operator prediction.
not_done: ES₅ digit encoding, transition weights, and spectral comparison with prime data.

summary: Fixed a directed denominator-splitting graph on vertices 1..100 using a→a+1 and a→a(a+1) when in range. It has 108 edges, all strictly increase the denominator, and hence no directed 2-cycles; this simple expansion graph is not the proposed ES certificate-move graph.
not_done: ES transformations and graph return probabilities.
next: Define certificate-preserving ES moves and compute bounded-height first-return statistics.

summary: Fixed the proxy alphabet as all words of length 3 over digits 1..A; counts for A=1,2,3,5,10 are 1,8,27,125,1,000. This word count does not establish Schottky separation or estimate δ_A, so it gives no Hausdorff-dimension conclusion for ES₅.
not_done: ES₅ matrices, separation domain, and pressure/dimension computation.
next: Fix the ES₅ matrix encoding and prove/check separation before computing pressure.

summary: Read the stated lattice definition Lρ(g)={(M,Y):Y≡ρM mod g} and tested Q=M²+pY² on 44 admissible (p,g,ρ) instances (p≤97, g<30). The Gram determinants were all positive, consistent with a positive-definite binary form rather than a Lorentzian lattice; this rules out reflectivity for this stated form, not for a separately defined lattice.
not_done: No alternate Lorentzian ES lattice was specified or tested.
next: Revisit only if a distinct Lorentzian ES lattice is defined.
